definitions: A minute arachnid that has a spherical or ovoid body and a piercing and sucking mouthpart. Mites are external parasites of animals and plants or live by scavenging.
A small or tiny amount of something.
A small coin, especially one of low value.
examples: The cheese was covered in mites.
He contributed his mite to the charity.
She gave her last mite to the beggar.
